title: Difficulty ladders
about: Every test built as a ten-rung difficulty ladder (case ids L01 to L10, frozen forever, each strictly harder than the one below along one documented size or depth). The headline is the ladder height: the highest level L such that every level 1..L was passed reliably. A rung is passed at passMark of its points (1 = full marks). src/core/ladders.ts validates this file and computes heights; docs/METHODOLOGY.md 'Difficulty ladders' is the contract. Planned tests are being built: when one lands, delete its "planned": true and add its ten rung labels.

tests.name: Run It In Your Head
tests.grows: Program length: statements executed in your head, from about 150 to about 73,000.

tests.name: No Calculator
tests.grows: Number size: a^e mod m with 8-digit numbers up to 44-digit numbers.

tests.name: The Sliding Ladder
tests.grows: Board size and the proven-shortest plan: 20 moves on 3×3 up to 56 moves on 4×4.

tests.name: The Picture Logic Ladder
tests.grows: Grid size: an 8×8 picture up to 50×50 (2,500 cells), case analysis required from level 3.

tests.name: Count Every Tiling
tests.grows: Board size: domino tilings of a 6×6 board (110) up to an 18×18 one (31 digits).

tests.name: Deduction Grid: Ladder
tests.grows: Grid size × attributes × clue depth: more people, more attributes and longer chains of clues to combine.

tests.name: Knights & Knaves: Ladder
tests.grows: Islanders and statement depth: more people, nested statements, then spies and alternators.

tests.name: Shortest Plans: Ladder
tests.grows: State-space size and the proven-minimum plan length.

tests.name: Exact Maths: Ladder
tests.grows: Board 10→64 squares, 0→6 snake loops, more ladders and traps; exact answer 3→30-digit denominator.

tests.name: Engineering: Ladder
tests.grows: One more range operation per level (2→12: add, assign, chmin, chmax, division, historic max/min, history reset) on up to 10^6 numbers; from level 5 only segment tree beats is fast enough.

tests.name: Invoices to Pay: Ladder
tests.grows: Dependency depth: from a handful of invoices under two rules to ten pools of eight documents each drawing on what the ones before them left, under the full payment policy.

tests.name: Check the Payslips: Ladder
tests.grows: Months that rest on each other: one month's payslips, up to six months of a payroll on the cumulative basis with code changes, P45s, directors and linked sickness.

tests.name: Expense Policy Check: Ladder
tests.grows: Months that rest on each other: one batch under two rules, up to six monthly batches for one team with mileage, duplicates, late lines and cash advances carried through.

tests.name: Reconcile the Account: Ladder
tests.grows: Months that rest on each other: one month's statement, up to six unreconciled months where items clear late and every balance carries all earlier corrections.

tests.name: Clean the Customer List: Ladder
tests.grows: Records merged one pair at a time: 24 records to about 950, with link records, refused merges and survivorship precedence.

tests.name: What Changed in the Contract?: Ladder
tests.grows: Draft length and settlement: 3 accepted changes to 114 changes settled by about 100 replies, keyed by the agreed numbering.

tests.name: Ask the Database: Ladder
tests.grows: Query depth: semantics one query must compose, from a filter to state carried row by row (as-of balances, a budget run).

tests.name: Customer Support Queue: Ladder
tests.grows: Tickets and history: 4 independent returns to 120 tickets from 36 accounts whose limits are used up in date order.
